steps: Take a free online course on IT documentation (e.g., Google IT Support Certificate on Coursera)
Practice help-desk scenarios using a free ticketing system like osTicket or Spiceworks
Learn basic desktop support skills with a CompTIA A+ study guide
Build a small project using a programming language (e.g., Python or JavaScript) to start developer path
Explore diagnostic tools like Wireshark or Windows Performance Monitor for end-user support
